name: SINxHOLIC
source:
Follow Rumi Ulrich, a human who is dropped off into a monster society known as Grim Town, as he helps the Grim Reaper solve a deadly murder mystery, uncover the secrets of the Seven Sins, and... run a monster cafe!?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250614102531/https://pacchistudio.itch.io/sinxholic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随人类鲁米·乌尔里希，来到名为格里姆镇的怪物社会，帮助死神破解致命的谋杀谜案，揭开七宗罪的秘密，以及…经营一家怪物咖啡馆？！

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250614102531/https://pacchistudio.itch.io/sinxholic]itch.io[/url]]
